name: Remake Lover
storyline:
A girl waking up from coma, finds out she was in an underground lab
After knowing how she get there, she realized she was one of five clones,
After she ken the fate of other four clones, she decided to forgive the man who cloned her--a man who suffered from the sorrow of lossing his partner from a car crash, so he desided to clone her.
summary:
If you can bring back your passed lover, would you change her ?

This is a short Visual Novel

A reconstructed lover awakens within an unfamiliar underground facility.

You will accompany her as she explores the silent structure, uncovering videotapes, journals, and experimental records.

Behind every door at the end of the corridor lies the existence of another “her” — identical in appearance, yet fundamentally different.

As she opens each room one by one,

the two of you will piece together everything that happened between them.

This is a story about love, obsession, identity, and the self.

About four reconstructed selves, and an experiment of love that could never be stopped.
